entries.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the family-15 incline body laid prone on the same pad (the instructions say chest-down; the stored template reads lying on the back and the instructions win - open question recorded at the checkpoint), legs to the floor. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a chest-supported dumbbell row on an

frames.caption: Let both dumbbells hang from the shoulders with the chest on the pad.
Pull with the elbows toward the ceiling.
Row until the shoulder blades pinch.
Hold with the shoulder blades pinched.
Reach a full hang and let the blades stretch apart.
